java.lang.Object
javafx.scene.Node

net.tessel.fx.components.Avatar
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.css.Styleable, javafx.event.EventTarget
public class Avatar extends javafx.scene.layout.StackPane
A circular avatar: a picture, or the initials of a name on a color derived from the name. 
new Avatar("Ada Lovelace", 40);
